summary: Phase 3d ambulance marketplace (real partner operators + admin KYC + 15% commission). Full E2E verified end-to-end across 2 browser contexts (operator freeuser + patient famtester) plus admin panel. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS. Frontend marketplace flow PASS: operator dashboard with documents/commission/online toggle -> patient request (cardiac+SB Pay) -> operator feed sees request -> operator accepts -> patient crew card shows 'SOS Ambu Test · VSAV · AB-12-CD' -> operator 'Je suis sur place' -> patient complete button -> done screen. Admin /admin/ambulance-operators shows KPIs (0 pending, 1 approved, 72,00€ commission, 408,00€ payout, GMV 480€ across 4 interventions = exact 15% split), commission input+save works, operator row 'SOS Ambu Test' Validé.

minor.issue: First pytest run failed with 'Solde SB Pay insuffisant' — famtester wallet had been drained to 74€ by prior iterations, below cardiac base_fee (120€). After topping up wallet to 5000€ for test purposes, all 6/6 pytest pass. Suggest the pytest fixture top up famtester's wallet (or use payment_method='cash' for the KYC flow assertion) to keep the suite repeatable across iterations.

action_items: (minor) Make pytest test_operator_kyc_and_real_marketplace_flow self-contained: top up famtester's wallet before completion OR use payment_method='cash' for the assertion so the suite stays green without DB seeding between iterations.

(observation, not a bug) The 'Valider' button (data-testid amb-approve-<uid>) is conditionally rendered only when the operator is not already 'approved'; in our run only the 'Refuser' button was shown because freeuser was already validated. Review request mentioned both buttons; current UX is correct (approved operators no longer need re-approving).
critical_code_review_comments: ambulance.py is well-structured: atomic accept via find_one_and_update with status+operator_id guards (avoids race), commission split applied only when payment_method='sbpay' AND operator_kind='real' (correct), fallback to simulated crew after FALLBACK_SECONDS=18s via the GET /requests/{id} endpoint (no background job — neat).

complete_request: SB Pay debit uses atomic balance>=total check, transaction is logged. Commission/operator earning persisted on the request doc AND in ambulance_revenue collection — good for admin reporting.
operator_online correctly blocks (403) non-approved operators, accept also re-checks approved status — defense in depth.
_public excludes Mongo _id ✓, error handling returns proper 4xx codes with French messages ✓.
